title: Principal-open geometry of an open relative affine line
statement: Let $Y=\operatorname{Spec}R$ be a Noetherian affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], where Noetherian means locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]. Put $A=\mathbf A^1_Y=\operatorname{Spec}R[t]$ [def-nagata-relative-affine-space]. For $s\in R[t]$ write $D(s)=\{\mathfrak p:s\notin\mathfrak p\}$ with its open subscheme structure. For every open subscheme $U\subseteq A$, the schemes $A,U$ are Noetherian and quasi-separated, the restricted projection $U\to Y$ is separated of finite type [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and there are $r\geq0$ and $s_1,\ldots,s_r\in R[t]$ with $D(s_i)\subseteq U$ and $U=\bigcup_iD(s_i)$. Every nonempty finite intersection of this family is $D(s_{i_1}\cdots s_{i_k})$ and is affine; its projection to $Y$ is affine, separated, of finite type, and smooth of relative dimension one [pqf-def-affine-morphism] [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. More generally, these properties hold for $D(s)\to Y$ for every $s\in R[t]$. If $g:T\to D(s)$ is finite etale and $T'\subseteq T$ is open and closed, then $T'$ is affine and Noetherian and the composite $T'\to D(s)\to Y$ is affine, separated, of finite type, and smooth of relative dimension one. Empty opens, the empty cover when $U=\varnothing$, and empty $T'$ are allowed.

proof.text: For p = Spec(Polynomial.C), prove SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 directly on the specified polynomial chart: transport MvPolynomial.isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension for the singleton variable type Unit through MvPolynomial.uniqueAlgEquiv, then use RingHom.locally_of and HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff. This avoids identifying Spec R[t] with the separately constructed relative affine space. SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth gives Smooth p and the existing smooth/finite-presentation instances give LocallyOfFiniteType p. Since the source and target are affine, p is affine and separated.

The equivalence isLocallyNoetherian_Spec makes R Noetherian. Hilbert basis and the Spec instance make Spec R[t] Noetherian. The open U is locally Noetherian by restriction and compact because every subset of a Noetherian space is compact, hence Noetherian. Local Noetherianity gives quasi-separatedness. The restricted projection U -> Spec R is separated and locally of finite type by the open-immersion and composition instances, and quasi-compact because its source has Noetherian topology.

Index the basic opens D(s) contained in U by the subtype B of such polynomials. The basis theorem covers U by this family. Apply IsCompact.elim_finite_subcover to obtain a finite subset t of B. The equivalence (Fintype.equivFin t).symm enumerates its elements by Fin (card t). The subset conditions and the finite-subcover equality give the required finite principal cover, including the empty case.

For every finite subset J of indices, pass to underlying sets using Opens.coe_iInf (the indexing subtype is finite). Membership in the intersection means that no indexed polynomial belongs to the prime. Ideal.IsPrime.prod_mem_iff says exactly that the finite product belongs to the prime iff some factor does. Thus the intersection is the basic open of the product. IsAffineOpen.Spec_basicOpen makes it affine. The calculation even holds when J is empty.

For an arbitrary polynomial s, use IsAffineOpen.Spec_basicOpen to make D(s) affine. Its open inclusion has SmoothOfRelativeDimension 0 directly by Mathlib; compose with p using smoothOfRelativeDimension_comp to obtain relative dimension 0+1=1. Smoothness gives local finite presentation and local finite type. A map between affine schemes is affine, hence separated and quasi-compact. No nonemptiness is required.

Let g:T -> D(s) be finite etale and V an open and closed subscheme of T. The finite map makes T affine. The inclusion V -> T has inducing underlying map and closed range (Scheme.Opens.range_ι), so Mathlib isAffineHom_of_isInducing makes it affine directly, without constructing a closed immersion. Hence V is affine. Etale g has relative dimension zero directly in Mathlib. Compose g with D(s) -> Spec R, and then the open inclusion V -> T, to obtain relative dimension one. Its smoothness gives local finite type. Its affine source and target give affineness, separatedness and quasi-compactness. LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian makes V locally Noetherian; affineness supplies compactness, so V is Noetherian. All arguments apply to empty V and empty D(s).
